answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring collateral as an inlet for network participation. An agent attempting to flood the system is forced to purchase stake, essentially sequestering their capital on an isolated island of locked assets. If an entity coordinates malicious activity, the protocol severs their influence, effectively trapping their capital in a stagnant lagoon of slashed value, rendering the attack cost-prohibitive.
